title: Geismar v. Abraham & Straus — a statutory consumer remedy
shortTitle: Geismar v. Abraham & Straus — a statutory consumer remedy
summary: The note contrasts an unsuccessful ordinary contract claim with a statutory remedy for advertising.
notes: Absence of an offer under contract doctrine need not dispose of every legally recognized wrong connected with advertising. The example identifies different causes of action rather than changing Lefkowitz’s offer analysis.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 203–204. Open assigned page 203.
